scanNote:
1-UNITNING IKKINCHI BETI (7-bet). Fon - och rangdagi dunyo xaritasi (chapda) va ko'k osmon (o'ngda).

Yuqorida o'ngda kichik yozuv: 'People around the World' va katta '1' raqami (unit belgisi).

O'ng tomonda suratlar (5-mashqda tilga olingan E - L):
• E - plyajda qirg'oqqa tortilgan uzun rangli qayiqlar, orqada palmalar
• F - sholi dalasida egilib ishlayotgan bir necha kishi (yashil maysazor)
• G - qizil fonda uch nafar an'anaviy tailand raqqosasi (oltin toj va libos)
• H - sakkiz qirrali ramkada qizil qalampirli guruchli taom
• I - sariq somon shlyapali, yuzini ro'mol bilan o'ragan kulib turgan dehqon ayol qo'lida o'simlik bog'lami
• J - daryoda tor qayiqda turgan odam suvga to'r tashlamoqda; orqada yog'och uy
• K - oval ramkada FUTBOL o'ynayotgan fil (ustida qizil futbolkali odam), oldida to'p, orqada tomoshabinlar
• L - baland buddaviylik ibodatxonasi minoralari (stupa), pastda to'q sariq libosdagi rohib

Chap ustunda:
6) 'Match the activities to the pictures.' - beshta gap, har birida nuqtali joy.
7) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Read statements 1 - 5, then listen and mark them as T (true) or F (false).' - beshta gap.

So'ng to'q sariq harflar bilan 'Reading' sarlavhasi.
8) a) 'Read the article and answer the questions, then explain the words in bold.' - sakkizta savol ikki ustunda.
   b) 'Read the text again and underline the phrases which best describe pictures E - K.'

Pastda yirtilgan qog'oz shaklidagi maqola: 'Hello, People of Thailand!' Matnda qalin harflar bilan berilgan so'zlar: holiday destination, delicate features, generous, kind, strong wills, proud of, spicy, noodles, Popular, traditional, fascinating.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '7'.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the activities to the pictures.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS - suratdagi ish.

  Qolip: are/is + fe'l + -ing

  ⚠ Suratni tasvirlashda DOIM shu zamon.


SURATLAR:
  E - plyajdagi uzun qayiqlar
  F - sholi dalasida ishlayotgan odamlar
  G - an'anaviy raqs
  H - o'tkir taom
  I - o'simlik bog'lamini ushlagan dehqon ayol
  J - daryoda to'r bilan baliq ovlash
  K - futbol o'ynayotgan fil
  L - buddaviylik ibodatxonasi


⚠ 'TO CATCH FISH':

  'fish' KO'PLIKDA ham 'fish' bo'ladi.
  ⚠ 'fishes' juda kam ishlatiladi (turlar
  haqida gapirilganda).

  ⚠ 'to catch' - noto'g'ri fe'l:
     catch - caught - caught


⚠ 'ELEPHANT FOOTBALL':

  Tailandda haqiqiy an'ana - fillar
  futbol o'ynaydigan musobaqalar
  (matnda: Surin shahrida, noyabrda).


⚠ 'A FIELD' va 'FIELDS':

  'to work in the fieldS' - KO'PLIKDA,
  chunki dala bitta emas.


⚠ 'CROPS' va 'PLANT':

  'a crop' = ekin, hosil
  'to plant' = ekmoq

  ⚠ 'plant' ham OT ('o'simlik'), ham
  FE'L ('ekmoq') bo'ladi.

pairs.right: J - a man throwing a net from a boat
pairs.whyUz:
J suratida daryoda qayiqdan to'r tashlanmoqda.

⚠ 'fish' ko'plikda ham 'fish'.
⚠ catch - caught - caught (noto'g'ri fe'l).

K suratida fil to'p oldida turibdi, ustida odam.

⚠ Matnda: 'in Surin, in November, when we
always have elephant football matches'.

pairs.left: 3  They are working in the fields.
pairs.right: F - people working in a rice field
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'in the fieldS' - KO'PLIKDA.

⚠ Matnda: 'The men usually work in the
fields or catch fish in the rivers.'

pairs.left: 4  They are doing a traditional dance.
pairs.right: G - three dancers in traditional costume
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'to DO a dance' - 'to make' EMAS.
Bu COLLOCATION.

⚠ Matnda: 'watching traditional dance shows'.

pairs.right: I - a woman farmer holding plants
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Gap BIRLIKDA ('She'), demak suratda BITTA
ayol bo'lishi kerak - bu I surati.

⚠ Matnda: 'the women plant the crops'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read statements 1 - 5, then listen and mark them as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: 1 - 5 gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TINGLASh MAShQI.

  ⚠ Kassetada 'Hello, People of Thailand!'
  maqolasi o'qiladi - ya'ni javoblar shu
  betdagi MATNDA ham bor.

  ⚠ Shuning uchun bu mashqni matnni o'qib
  ham bajarish mumkin.


⚠ T/F MAShQINING QOIDASI:

  Har gapni matndagi ANIQ gap bilan
  solishtiring. BITTA so'z farq qilsa ham
  javob F bo'ladi.

  ⚠ Eng ko'p uchraydigan tuzoq -
  ALMAShTIRILGAN SO'Z:
     matn: 'south-east ASIA'
     savol: 'south-east EUROPE'  → F


⚠ 'A JEWEL':

  = qimmatbaho tosh, javohir.
  ⚠ 'the jewel of south-east Asia' -
  ko'chma ma'no: eng go'zal joy.

items.sentence: 1  People call Thailand 'the jewel of south-east Europe'.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'the jewel of south-east
ASIA' - Yevropa emas, OSIYo.

⚠ Tailand Osiyoda joylashgan.

TO'G'RI. Matnda: 'The Thais are friendly
people who are well known for being generous
and kind.'

items.sentence: 3  Most people in Thailand live in cities.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'Most people in Thailand
live in VILLAGES' - shaharda emas, QIShLOQDA.

items.sentence: 4  Family life is not very important in Thailand.
items.whyUz:
NOTO'G'RI. Matnda: 'Family life is VERY
IMPORTANT in Thailand.' - inkor qo'shilgan.

items.sentence: 5  Thai people love to enjoy themselves.
items.whyUz:
TO'G'RI. Matnda: 'Thai people love to enjoy
themselves.'

⚠ 'to enjoy oneself' = ko'ngil ochmoq,
yayramoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI
bandlarda berilgan.


⚠ MATNNING TUZILIShI - BESh QISM:

  1) Kirish shior: hammamiz bir
     dunyoning odamlarimiz
  2) Mamlakat: qayerda, iqlimi, nimasi
     mashhur
  3) Odamlar: tashqi qiyofa va xarakter
  4) Turmush: qishloq, ish, oila, ovqat
  5) Bo'sh vaqt va yakun

  ⚠ Bu - 'article' (maqola) janrining
  odatiy tuzilishi. 11-betdagi yozish
  mashqida siz ham shunday maqola
  yozasiz.


⚠ MATNDA IKKI MARTA TIRNOQ IChIDA
GAP BOR:

  '...' says Kasem from Bangkok.
  '...' explains Kasem.

  ⚠ Bu - 'a quotation' (iqtibos).
  Maqolada haqiqiy odamning so'zi
  keltiriladi - matn ishonchli bo'ladi.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR (8a mashqida
tushuntirish so'raladi):

  holiday destination = ta'til manzili
  delicate features   = nozik yuz
                        tuzilishi
  generous            = saxovatli
  kind                = mehribon
  strong wills        = kuchli iroda
  proud of            = ... dan faxrlanadi
  spicy               = o'tkir, ziravorli
  noodles             = ugra, lag'mon
  popular             = mashhur, ommabop
  traditional         = an'anaviy
  fascinating         = maftunkor

points.en: Whatever country we come from, whatever colour our skin is, we all have one thing in common: we are all people of the world.
points.uz: Qaysi mamlakatdan bo'lsak ham, terimizning rangi qanday bo'lsa ham, bizda bitta umumiy narsa bor: hammamiz dunyo odamlarimiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'whatever' = qanday bo'lmasin, har qanday.

⚠ 'to have sth in common' = umumiy narsaga
ega bo'lmoq. Turg'un ibora.

⚠ 'colour' - Britaniya imlosi (AQSh: 'color').

points.en: Thailand is a beautiful country with a rich culture, just south of China.
points.uz: Tailand - boy madaniyatga ega go'zal mamlakat, Xitoydan janubda.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'south of China' = Xitoydan janubda.
Predlog 'of' bilan.

⚠ 'rich' bu yerda 'boy' (pul emas, madaniyat).

points.en: People call it 'the jewel of south-east Asia' for a good reason.
points.uz: Odamlar uni bejiz 'janubi-sharqiy Osiyoning javohiri' deb atamaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a jewel' = javohir, qimmatbaho tosh.
⚠ 'for a good reason' = bejiz emas, asosli sabab bilan.

⚠ 'to call sth sth' - ikki to'ldiruvchi:
'call IT the jewel'.

points.en: Its tropical climate, white sandy beaches and ancient temples make it a perfect holiday destination.
points.uz: Tropik iqlimi, oq qumli plyajlari va qadimiy ibodatxonalari uni mukammal ta'til manziliga aylantiradi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'ITS' (apostrofsiz) = uning (egalik).
'IT'S' (apostrof bilan) = 'it is'.
Bu - eng ko'p xato qilinadigan juftlik.

⚠ 'a destination' = manzil, borish joyi.
⚠ 'ancient' = qadimiy.

points.en: What makes it really special, though, is its people.
points.uz: Uni haqiqatan ham alohida qiladigan narsa esa - uning xalqi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'though' gap oxirida = 'lekin, esa'.
Verguller bilan ajratiladi.

⚠ 'What makes it special IS ...' - bu
'cleft sentence': fikrni ta'kidlash qolipi.

points.en: Thai people are good-looking. They are short with delicate features.
points.uz: Tailandliklar chiroyli. Ular past bo'yli, nozik yuz tuzilishiga ega.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'good-looking' = chiroyli (erkak va ayol uchun
ham). DEFIS bilan yoziladi.

⚠ 'delicate' = nozik, mayin.
⚠ 'features' = yuz tuzilishi (ko'z, burun, og'iz).

points.en: They have got black hair, dark eyes and light brown skin.
points.uz: Ularning sochi qora, ko'zlari to'q rangli, terisi och jigarrang.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'have got' - Britaniya egaligi.
⚠ 'hair' va 'skin' - SANALMAYDIGAN otlar.

⚠ 'light brown' = och jigarrang;
'dark brown' = to'q jigarrang.

points.en: The Thais are friendly people who are well known for being generous and kind.
points.uz: Tailandliklar - saxovatli va mehribonligi bilan mashhur samimiy xalq.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'THE Thais' - millat nomi oldidan 'the'.
⚠ 'well known FOR' + -ING shakli.

⚠ 'generous' = saxovatli; 'kind' = mehribon.

points.en: "We are a happy people who have strong wills and are especially proud of our history," says Kasem from Bangkok.
points.uz: "Biz kuchli irodali va tariximizdan alohida faxrlanadigan baxtli xalqmiz", - deydi Bangkoklik Kasem.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a people' (artikl bilan) = XALQ, millat.
'people' (artiklsiz) = odamlar.

⚠ 'a will' = iroda.
⚠ 'proud OF' - predlog 'of'.

points.en: Most people in Thailand live in villages.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'most people' - artiklsiz.
⚠ 'THE most' faqat qiyoslashda: 'the most
beautiful'.

points.en: A typical Thai village consists of wooden houses, a school and a Buddhist temple.
points.uz: Odatiy tailand qishlog'i yog'och uylar, maktab va buddaviylik ibodatxonasidan iborat.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to consist OF' - predlog 'of' HAR DOIM.
⚠ 'wooden' = yog'ochdan ('wood' + -EN).
⚠ 'Buddhist' - katta harf bilan (din nomi).

points.en: The men usually work in the fields or catch fish in the rivers, and the women plant the crops.
points.uz: Erkaklar odatda dalada ishlaydi yoki daryolarda baliq ovlaydi, ayollar esa ekin ekadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE - odat, doimiy ish.
⚠ 'usually' - takrorlanish ravishi, asosiy
fe'ldan OLDIN turadi.

points.en: Family life is very important in Thailand, and families often eat together.
points.uz: Tailandda oila hayoti juda muhim va oilalar ko'pincha birga ovqatlanadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'often' - takrorlanish ravishi, asosiy
fe'ldan OLDIN: 'often EAT'.

⚠ 7-mashqning 4-gapida aynan shu jumla
inkor qilingan edi → javob F.

points.en: Thai food is very spicy and includes curries, fish, seafood, soups and noodles.
points.uz: Tailand taomi juda o'tkir bo'lib, karri, baliq, dengiz mahsulotlari, sho'rvalar va ugrani o'z ichiga oladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'spicy' = o'tkir, ziravorli ('a spice' = ziravor).
⚠ 'noodles' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.
⚠ 'to include' = o'z ichiga olmoq.

points.en: "We eat rice with our meals and use a lot of strong spices in our cooking," explains Kasem.
points.uz: "Biz ovqatimiz bilan guruch yeymiz va pishirishda ko'p o'tkir ziravor ishlatamiz", - tushuntiradi Kasem.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a meal' = ovqatlanish mahali (nonushta,
tushlik, kechki ovqat).
⚠ 'a lot of' - sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan
otlar bilan ham ishlatiladi.

points.en: Thai people love to enjoy themselves. Popular free-time activities include Thai boxing and watching traditional dance shows.
points.uz: Tailandliklar ko'ngil ochishni yaxshi ko'radi. Ommabop bo'sh vaqt mashg'ulotlari - tailand boksi va an'anaviy raqs tomoshalarini ko'rish.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to enjoy ONESELF' = ko'ngil ochmoq.
O'zlik olmoshi ShART.

⚠ 'free-time' - defis bilan, chunki sifat
vazifasida.

points.en: Thais also celebrate many festivals throughout the year.
points.uz: Tailandliklar yil davomida ko'plab bayramlarni ham nishonlaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'throughout the year' = yil davomida.
⚠ 'to celebrate' = nishonlamoq.

points.en: "My favourite holiday is Surin, in November, when we always have elephant football matches," says Kasem.
points.uz: "Sevimli bayramim - noyabrdagi Surin, unda biz doim fil futboli musobaqalarini o'tkazamiz", - deydi Kasem.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'favourite' - Britaniya imlosi (AQSh:
'favorite').
⚠ 'in November' - oy oldidan 'in'.

⚠ K suratidagi fil futboli aynan shu.

points.en: Thailand is a wonderful country. Its fascinating sights, rich cultural history and warm-hearted people make it unique.
points.uz: Tailand - ajoyib mamlakat. Uning maftunkor manzaralari, boy madaniy tarixi va ochiqko'ngil odamlari uni betakror qiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'fascinating' = maftunkor.
⚠ 'a sight' = ko'rgazmali joy, manzara.
⚠ 'warm-hearted' = ochiqko'ngil (warm + heart).
⚠ 'unique' = betakror, yagona.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article and answer the questions, then explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani o'qing va savollarga javob bering, so'ng qalin harfli so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOLLARGA MATNDAN JAVOB TOPISh.

  ⚠ Bu 'reading for specific information'
  deb ataladi: butun matnni tushunish
  shart emas, faqat KERAKLI joyni topish.


⚠ IKKI SAVOLNI ADAShTIRMANG:

  'What do they LOOK LIKE?'
     = qanday KO'RINADI (tashqi qiyofa)
     → short, black hair, dark eyes

  'What ARE they LIKE?'
     = qanday ODAM (xarakter)
     → friendly, generous, kind

  ⚠ Matnda ikkalasi ham bor va mashqda
  ular KETMA-KET so'ralgan (2 va 3-savol) -
  ataylab, farqni ko'rsatish uchun.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  holiday destination - ta'til manzili
  delicate features - nozik yuz tuzilishi
  generous - saxovatli
  kind - mehribon
  strong wills - kuchli iroda
  proud of - ... dan faxrlanadi
  spicy - o'tkir, ziravorli
  noodles - ugra
  popular - ommabop
  traditional - an'anaviy
  fascinating - maftunkor

items.question: Where is Thailand?
items.answer: It's in south-east Asia, just south of China.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'a beautiful country ... just south of
China' va 'the jewel of south-east Asia'.

items.question: What do Thais look like?
items.answer: They are short with delicate features, black hair, dark eyes and light brown skin.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'look like' - TAShQI QIYoFA.

Matnda: 'They are short with delicate features.
They have got black hair, dark eyes and light
brown skin.'

items.question: What are they like?
items.answer: They are friendly, generous and kind.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'be like' - XARAKTER.

Matnda: 'friendly people who are well known
for being generous and kind'.

items.question: Where do they live?
items.answer: Most of them live in villages.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'Most people in Thailand live in
villages.'

items.question: What do their villages consist of?
items.answer: They consist of wooden houses, a school and a Buddhist temple.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to consist OF' - predlog 'of'.

Matnda: 'A typical Thai village consists of
wooden houses, a school and a Buddhist temple.'

items.question: What do the people do?
items.answer: The men work in the fields or catch fish, and the women plant the crops.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'What do you do?' = kasbingiz nima?

Matnda: 'The men usually work in the fields or
catch fish in the rivers, and the women plant
the crops.'

items.question: What do they love eating?
items.answer: They love eating rice, curries, fish, seafood, soups and noodles.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'love' dan keyin -ING yoki 'to' + fe'l -
ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

Matnda: 'Thai food is very spicy and includes
curries, fish, seafood, soups and noodles.'

items.question: What do they do in their free time?
items.answer: They do Thai boxing, watch traditional dance shows and celebrate festivals.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'Popular free-time activities include
Thai boxing and watching traditional dance
shows. Thais also celebrate many festivals.'

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text again and underline the phrases which best describe pictures E - K.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni qayta o'qing va E - K suratlarini eng yaxshi tasvirlaydigan iboralar tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATNNI SURAT BILAN BOG'LASh.

  ⚠ Bu mashq matnni IKKINChI MARTA
  o'qishga majbur qiladi - va aynan shu
  takroriy o'qish so'zlarni yodda
  qoldiradi.

  ⚠ Bu 'scanning' deb ataladi: butun matnni
  o'qimasdan, kerakli iborani KO'Z BILAN
  IZLASh.


⚠ HAR SURAT MATNNING QAYSI QISMIGA
TEGIShLI:

  E, J → qishloq turmushi haqidagi
         xatboshi
  F, I → 'work in the fields' /
         'plant the crops'
  G    → bo'sh vaqt haqidagi xatboshi
  H    → ovqat haqidagi xatboshi
  K    → Kasemning oxirgi gapi

pairs.left: E - long boats on a sandy beach
pairs.whyUz:
Matnda: 'Its tropical climate, WHITE SANDY
BEACHES and ancient temples make it a perfect
holiday destination.'

pairs.left: F - people working in a rice field
pairs.right: The men usually work in the fields

pairs.whyUz:
Bo'sh vaqt haqidagi xatboshidan.

⚠ 'a show' = tomosha, ko'rsatuv.

⚠ Suratdagi qizil qalampir - 'spicy' so'zining
ko'rinishi.

⚠ 'a spice' = ziravor → 'spicy' = ziravorli.

pairs.left: I - a woman farmer holding plants
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Suratda AYoL - matnda ham 'the WOMEN'.

⚠ 'to plant' = ekmoq; 'a crop' = ekin.

pairs.left: J - a man catching fish from a boat

pairs.whyUz:
Kasemning oxirgi gapidan: 'My favourite holiday
is Surin, in November, when we always have
ELEPHANT FOOTBALL MATCHES.'

sentencePatterns.introUz: Mamlakat va xalq haqida maqola qoliplari.

patterns.exampleEn: Thailand is a beautiful country with a rich culture.
patterns.exampleUz: Tailand - boy madaniyatga ega go'zal mamlakat.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'with' + xususiyat - qisqa va chiroyli qolip.
⚠ 11-betdagi yozish mashqida kerak bo'ladi.

patterns.exampleEn: People call it 'the jewel of south-east Asia'.
patterns.exampleUz: Odamlar uni 'janubi-sharqiy Osiyoning javohiri' deb ataydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to call sth sth' - ikki to'ldiruvchi, predlogsiz.
⚠ 'call it AS the jewel' - XATO.

patterns.exampleEn: They are short with delicate features.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular past bo'yli, nozik yuz tuzilishiga ega.

patterns.exampleEn: A typical Thai village consists of wooden houses and a school.
patterns.exampleUz: Odatiy tailand qishlog'i yog'och uylar va maktabdan iborat.

patterns.exampleEn: They are well known for being generous.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'for' PREDLOG, shuning uchun keyin -ING shakli:
'for BEING', 'for HELPING'.

groups.explanationUz: Ikki so'z defis bilan birikib bitta sifat hosil qiladi. Matnda uchtasi bor.
Matnda 'Its tropical climate' va 'Its fascinating sights' - ikkalasi ham EGALIK.
